references.text: Warns against performing religious acts to be seen by others, similar to how Jesus warns against practicing righteousness before the eyes of people.
Focuses on sincerity in worship and sacrifice, which resonates with Jesus' call to practice righteousness not to be seen, but from a sincere heart.
Criticizes the Pharisees for making their religious acts visible to others, paralleling the warning in Matthew 6:1 not to practice righteousness to be seen by people.
